meta.name: materials-chemistry
meta.description: States of matter, phase transitions, kinetic molecular theory, atmospheric chemistry, green chemistry, and sustainable synthesis. Covers solid/liquid/gas/plasma properties, phase diagrams, vapor pressure, gas laws, ozone chemistry, greenhouse effect, the 12 principles of green chemistry, atom economy, solvent selection, and catalysis for sustainability. Use when reasoning about material properties, environmental chemistry, or designing greener chemical processes.
